oracleReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT DISTINCT CAST(ANOMES_VENDA AS VARCHAR2(6)) AS ANOMES_VENDA FROM ', pipeline().parameters.SchemaName, '.OKJ_DIMCABECALHOPEDIDOVENDA_PBI WHERE ANOMES_VENDA >= ''', pipeline().parameters.StartAnomes, ''' AND ANOMES_VENDA < ''', pipeline().parameters.EndAnomesExclusive, ''' ORDER BY 1')

@concat('SELECT NUMEROPEDIDO AS "numeropedido", NUMEROPEDIDORCA AS "numeropedidorca", CAST(NUMEROCARREGAMENTO AS NUMBER(10,0)) AS "numerocarregamento", CAST(NUMERONOTAFISCAL AS NUMBER(10,0)) AS "numeronotafiscal", CAST(NUMEROTRANSACAOVENDA AS NUMBER(10,0)) AS "numerotransacaovenda", CAST(CODFILIAL AS VARCHAR2(2)) AS "codfilial", DATAVENDA AS "datavenda", DATAPREVISAOFATURAMENTO AS "dataprevisaofaturamento", DATAFATURAMENTO AS "datafaturamento", DATACANCELAMENTO AS "datacancelamento", DATAENTREGA AS "dataentrega", HORA AS "hora", MINUTO AS "minuto", CAST(SITUACAO AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS "situacao", CONDICAOVENDADESCRICAO AS "condicaovendadescricao", CAST(CANCELADO AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS "cancelado", CAST(TIPOPEDIDO AS VARCHAR2(40)) AS "tipopedido", CODIGOTIPOPEDIDO AS "codigotipopedido", CONDICAOVENDA AS "condicaovenda", OBSERVACAOPEDIDO AS "observacaopedido", CAST(TIPOVENDA_NF AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS "tipovenda_nf", TIPOVENDA_NF_DESCRICAO AS "tipovenda_nf_descricao", CAST(ESPECIE_NF AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS "especie_nf", CAST(SERIE_NF AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS "serie_nf", CAST(ORIGEMPEDIDO AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS "origempedido", ANOMES_VENDA AS "anomes_venda" FROM ', pipeline().parameters.SchemaName, '.OKJ_DIMCABECALHOPEDIDOVENDA_PBI WHERE ANOMES_VENDA = ''', item().ANOMES_VENDA, '''')
